Bottom line: Prioritize managing your leveraged losing positions and stay vigilant on macro risks.
plays: Consider trimming or exiting SOXL, a 3x leveraged ETF down 37.45%. Leveraged products decay and amplify losses on margin.
Review SPAL, another leveraged ETF down 22.07%. Its fast moves and decay make it a high-risk holding on margin.
